falsification_plan: Falsify if management commentary, filings, or call transcripts show no meaningful HBM, AI accelerator, HPC, foundry/logic, or advanced-packaging linkage behind recent growth.
Falsify if probe-card order growth is broad-based across mature nodes or memory recovery rather than concentrated in high-complexity applications.
Falsify if gross margin fails to improve, or declines, during periods when high-end probe-card demand is supposedly increasing.
Falsify if customer concentration disclosures or industry checks indicate share loss at key HBM, DRAM, foundry, or HPC customers.
Falsify if competitors show stronger evidence of HBM/AI probe-card wins, shorter lead times, better margins, or superior customer qualification status.
Falsify if advanced-packaging test economics accrue mainly to testers, OSATs, inspection/metrology vendors, or captive customer platforms rather than probe-card suppliers.
Falsify if backlog, bookings, or management commentary indicate normalization after a short cyclical restocking period instead of sustained structural demand.

risks: Cyclical false positive: order growth may reflect broad semiconductor recovery rather than structural HBM, AI accelerator, or advanced-packaging demand.
Evidence gap: FORM may not disclose enough HBM, AI, HPC, or advanced-packaging revenue detail to separate chokepoint exposure from generic probe-card sales.
Competition risk: higher probe-card complexity may attract or strengthen competitors, compressing margins despite demand growth.
Customer concentration risk: if a small number of memory or foundry/logic customers drive demand, share loss or delayed capex at one customer could materially weaken the thesis.

Value migration risk: advanced packaging could shift more test value toward other tools, outsourced semiconductor assembly/test vendors, package-level test platforms, or vertically integrated customer solutions.

Market-recognition risk: the external context warns that the market has already identified many suppliers one layer below HBM producers, so FORM may be less mispriced than the underfollowed label implies.
Margin-risk mismatch: if high-end probe-card mix rises but gross margin does not improve, the supposed complexity premium may be weaker than expected.
Qualification-cycle downside: long certification cycles can create defensibility, but they can also delay revenue conversion and make share shifts hard to detect until late.
deep_reports.supply_chain_position: AI compute demand -> HBM and advanced logic/chiplet production -> wafer-level testing and yield learning -> probe stations, probe cards, test interfaces, thermal/electrical contact systems -> customer-specific qualification at memory, foundry/logic, and advanced-packaging customers. FORM sits below the obvious AI accelerator and HBM producers, at the interface where advanced wafers/packages must be electrically contacted and tested before yield ramp and volume production. Reference leaders include AI compute vendors, HBM producers, foundries, and advanced-packaging capacity owners; FORM is the underfollowed supplier-level candidate one layer below those leaders.
deep_reports.thesis_cn: 假设：FormFactor 可能受益于 AI 加速器、HBM、chiplet 和先进封装带来的测试复杂度提升。核心逻辑不是“半导体设备周期复苏”，而是高端晶圆探针、探针卡和测试接口可能成为先进存储与高性能逻辑量产爬坡中的合格接口瓶颈。若 HBM、AI accelerator、foundry/logic 与 advanced packaging 相关收入占比提升，并带动探针卡订单、毛利率和客户认证壁垒改善，则 FORM 的业务属性可能从普通测试硬件供应商上修为先进制程/先进封装良率爬坡的关键节点。当前结论级别：hypothesis，需要财报、电话会、客户结构和订单/毛利证据验证。
deep_reports.thesis_en: Hypothesis: FormFactor may benefit as AI accelerators, HBM, chiplets, and advanced packaging raise the complexity of wafer probe, probe cards, and test interfaces. The core question is not simply whether semiconductor test spending recovers cyclically, but whether high-end probe cards are becoming scarce, qualified interfaces needed for yield learning and production ramps in advanced memory and high-performance logic. If HBM, AI accelerator, foundry/logic, and advanced-packaging exposure is rising and is visible in probe-card demand, gross margin mix, bookings, and customer qualification strength, FORM could deserve to be researched less as generic test hardware and more as a yield-ramp chokepoint. Current confidence level: hypothesis, pending filings, earnings-call, customer, order, and margin verification.

deep_reports.why_underfollowed: The market may miss the signal because semiconductor test hardware sounds cyclical, downstream, and less strategically important than GPUs, HBM producers, foundries, or packaging equipment. The underfollowed angle is that probe cards and wafer-probe interfaces may become more specialized as HBM stacks, chiplets, and advanced packages increase pin density, thermal constraints, signal-integrity requirements, and customer-specific qualification burdens. However, this is not a hidden mega-discovery: the supplied external context on the HBM supply chain says the market has largely identified many sub-$50B suppliers one layer beneath HBM producers, so the research edge must come from proving that FORM has unusually direct, durable, margin-accretive exposure rather than generic semiconductor beta.
